oemDescription1.en: At Busrom, we work closely with designers, retailers, and manufacturers to deliver end-to-end OEM/ODM services. We seamlessly integrate your ideas into glass hardware and provide bespoke glass solutions tailored to your needs.
oemDescription1.zh: 在 Busrom，我们与设计师、零售商和制造商紧密合作，提供端到端的 OEM/ODM 服务。我们将您的想法无缝融入玻璃五金，并提供量身定制的玻璃解决方案。

oemDescription2.en: Ready to turn your concept into a producible product? Send us your vision — the Busrom team will get back to you within 24 hours with a personalized partnership proposal.
oemDescription2.zh: 准备好将您的概念转化为可生产的产品了吗？向我们发送您的愿景——Busrom 团队将在 24 小时内回复您个性化的合作提案。

odmDescription1.zh: 完全定制的结构、尺寸和颜色
